system.longDesc: A rifle is far more dangerous in your hands.

degree0.desc: You can assume a high ready stance; as long as you do not move more than half your Speed, you can make an attack with a loaded rifle you are holding as a reaction before rolling initiative, even if surprised. This attack uses up your major action for the round, which means that you only have a minor action available during your next turn.

degree1.desc: You skillfully leverage your weapon’s ability to punch through cover. You ignore 2 points of any armor bonus provided by cover when using a longarm or assault rifle. When using those weapons, you also ignore the attack roll penalty imposed by the Human Shield action stunt.

degree2.desc: Penalties to the attack roll due to range do not apply to your attacks with a rifle.
